title: DreamSettings
description: Dreams in the computing night (B7 R8, A1409): the tones a dream may have and what each tone does in the core (mood, idea), the text length and the job priority. The AI only picks the tone; the effect is this data (frame, not outcome). Values are placeholders until Marcel decides.

max_chars.description: Length limit of a dream text.

max_events.description: Events of the day sent with a dream job (the most recent ones).

priority.description: Job priority of dream jobs (B7 O2); when they run is in content/hardware/night.json.

id.description: Tone id the AI picks (English word, it is part of the prompt).

mood.description: Mood the dream leaves in the morning (vocabulary moods), or null.

mood_strength.description: How strong that mood is (0..1; the core's mood model decides what it means).

idea.description: True: the dream's subject (about) becomes a little more interesting the next day (curiosity, ideas).

idea_strength.description: How much more interesting the dream's subject becomes (0..1; the core's curiosity model decides what it means). 0 when idea is false.

effect_hours.description: How long the mood and idea last after waking (game hours), then they fade.
